pattern.description: After the Fields change, the grouped idea table reflows in one step: the Bucket, Customers and Goal columns narrow and shift left, and rows within the Legacy Manufacturing group reorder (TS-4 above TS-9). The cursor then glides to the sidebar and hovers Roadmap, setting up the next view.
pattern.why_premium: The whole table updates as one coherent state so viewers see the result of the setting change at a glance, and the cursor immediately signposts the next destination, keeping the demo moving without a cut.

build_hint.gsap: Use a Flip-style reflow: record positions with Flip.getState('.col, .row'), apply the new layout, then Flip.from(state, {duration: 0.35, ease: 'power3.inOut', stagger: 0.015}) so columns slide left and swapped rows trade places. Afterwards gsap.to('.cursor', {x: sidebarX, y: roadmapY, duration: 0.45, ease: 'power2.inOut'}) and add the hover background to the Roadmap item on arrival.
build_hint.remotion: Interpolate each column's x and each row's y between old and new layout with spring({frame: frame - start, fps, config: {damping: 20, stiffness: 170, mass: 1}}) (no overshoot). Cursor path = interpolate(frame, [t0, t0 + 14], [fieldsPos, roadmapPos], {easing: Easing.inOut(Easing.cubic)}); Roadmap row background opacity steps to 1 when the cursor arrives.

notes: In the source the reflow is effectively instantaneous (f3327 to f3329 screen-recording jump), so the duration/easing estimates are low-value; the build hint describes a smoothed version. The sidebar collapse chevron (~x211,y117) appears on sidebar hover but has no candidate box and is tiny, so it is not listed. The bottom Emerging group row also changes (TS-9 replaced by TS-11 Automation) out of the candidate area.
